label.en: Ending: the vault is blown up

note.zh: 选择安放炸药后，星球获得“被毁的舱室”矿藏，事件链结束。
note.en: After choosing explosives the planet gets the "Destroyed Vault" deposit and the chain ends.

note.zh: 所有选项都把“山体地下舱室”替换为“运转中的工厂”；按国民理念/公民性另加岗位或修正。
note.en: Every option replaces the Mountainous Vault with the Operational Manufactorium deposit; civic-specific options add jobs or a modifier.

colony.9290.evidence: events/colony_events_3.txt:6563-6653: each option remove_deposit d_ancient_manufactorium_vaultexploration, add_deposit d_ancient_manufactorium_working.

notes.zh: 审阅注：选项“拆解它”不开启项目，而是把舱室换成“工厂回收厂”矿藏，事件链就此结束（colony_events_3.txt:6229-6234）。
notes.en: Review note: "Dismantle" opens no project; it swaps the vault for the Manufactorium Scrapyard deposit and ends the chain (colony_events_3.txt:6229-6234).

notes.zh: 审阅注：链中每个事件都重复检查殖民地仍由原主人持有、非首都、无地面战斗、未被占领；若延时到达时条件不满足，后续不会发生。
notes.en: Review note: every event in the chain re-checks that the colony is still held by its original owner, not the capital, without ground combat and not occupied; if that fails when a delayed event is due, the chain stops.

scope.zh: colony.9200–9290 全部26个事件与工厂项目：入口、每个按理念/公民性限定的选项、延时与两种结局。
scope.en: All 26 events colony.9200–9290 and the foundry project: entry, every ethic/civic-gated option, delays and both endings.

uncertain: The concrete yields of the final deposits depend on carrier flags set along the path (manufactorium_*); the deposit definitions were not traced in detail.

note.zh: 游戏里这里会出现这颗星球的名称。
note.en: In the game, the name of this planet appears here.
